NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 (Section 12) NOTICE No : 41/0222 Putthalam District It is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the owner-ship or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands reflected in the Cadastral Map No. 410111 made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 relating to the village of Manalkundu, Sec-tion No 04, Manalkundu (within the puttalam Municiple council limits) (Block 11) or any part thereof, situated within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 617 B - Putthalam East in the Divi-sional Secretariat Division of Putthalam in the District of Puttha-lam in the Province of North Western should submit his claim to the undersigned before 07th May, 2019 In the event of failure to submit any claim before the above-mentioned date, action will be taken to hold an exparte inquiry to determine title to the land and accordingly publish such determination in the Government Ga-zette in terms of Section 14 of the above Act. The Cadastral Map No. 410111 referred to above may be perused at the relevant Grama Niladhari Office, Divisional Secretariat, District Survey Office, Office of the Commissioner of Title Set-tlement, or the Surveyor - General’s office. Further information may be obtained from the Grama Niladhari, the Divisional Secretary, or the Commissioner of Land Title Set-tlement. K.A.K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement (Actg.) Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 28th March, 2019
